name: Layout Builder Direct Add
description: Converts the 'Add block' link in Layout Builder into a drop-button to directly add custom block types.
project_description:
The Layout Builder Direct Add module provides options select content block types from within the layout. This replaces the core Layout Builder "Add block" link. Options include:

 
 Drop-button with the first block as the default option with the rest of the blocks displayed when you click the down arrow (similar to Paragraphs button option). 
 Button to display an inline tray with a list of links. 
 
 Clicking on the link for a block type will take you directly to the add form for that block type. The "More..." link is included as the last item in the list and clicking on it opens the normal "Add block" sidebar.
